name: shipment-notifications
description: 2nd gen Firestore trigger: exactly one ready_for_pickup notification per delivered shipment

scripts.test:emulator: cd .. && npx -y firebase-tools@15.37.0 emulators:exec --config firebase.json --only functions,firestore --project demo-task3 "node --test --test-concurrency=1 'functions/test/emulator/*.test.js'"
scripts.test:repro: cd ../original && npm install --no-audit --no-fund --silent && cd .. && npx -y firebase-tools@15.37.0 emulators:exec --config firebase.repro.json --only functions,firestore --project demo-task3 "node --test 'functions/test/repro/*.test.js'"
